title: Essential Energy Field Worker R4 labour rate, overtime (quoted services, excl GST)

scope.classification: Essential Energy, Field Worker (R4), overtime, quoted services, excl GST

qualifications.text: *All rates in the below tables are exclusive of GST
* Essential Energy may impose an overtime hourly rate for services provided outside the hours of 7.30am and 4pm on a working day.
This attachment sets out the final decision of prices Essential Energy is allowed to charge customers for the provision of alternative control services.

Alternative control services are customer specific or customer requested services and so the full cost of the service is attributed to a particular customer, or group of customers, benefiting from the service.
